name: performance_attribution_spec
principle: Decomposition by SOURCE OF RETURN, never by instrument; composite ALWAYS leads; sleeve inceptions pre-registered; reclassification forbidden; n stated with every sleeve.

carry.definition: paid-for-bounded-risk: short-premium book (CSP/dead-chain/overwrites) + RP_FAIR carry equities

event_timing.definition: dated-event forecasting: event_options + catalyst-gated cash entries
event_timing.benchmark: dual counterfactuals (SPY-same-window + un-optioned underlying) + calibration Brier exhibit

overlays.cash_drag: reported as its own line (conservatism-audit C5 convention), never buried in the composite
overlays.exclusion_record: the anti-book — refused names + subsequent performance (the honesty layer as a reportable product)

marketing_gate: external use only when per-sleeve n supports it (event_timing: n>=10 w/ positive structure-value-add, per the event_options preregistration); until then this is an INTERNAL calibration instrument
migration_note: existing ledger sleeve tags map: court_gates/macau_wallet/korea_valueup -> function assignment at position level; the CSP book tags 'carry' at next touch; no retroactive P&L reclassification
